article.title: Restriction on practice after being a permanent Judge
article.content:
220Restriction on practice after being a permanent Judge

Article 220 · Part VI
No person who, after the commencement of this Constitution, has held office as a permanent Judge of a High Court shall plead or act in any court or before any authority in India except the Supreme Court and the other High Courts.
ExplanationIn this article, the expression “High Court” does not include a High Court for a State specified in Part B of the First Schedule as it existed before the commencement2 of the Constitution (Seventh Amendment) Act, 1956.

1 Subs. by s. 13, ibid. (w.e.f. 1-11-1956).
2 1st November, 1956.
